parsed.notes:
The 'We're excited about you because…' heading expresses the company's enthusiasm, not the candidate's appetite (golden_038). It is treated as the requirements section, so default required.
The 'You're excited about this opportunity because...' section is candidate appetite. Its neural networks, optimization, ML and multimodal AI mentions are nice_to_have. All except multimodal AI collapse into required mentions elsewhere.
The 'Deep expertise in at least one of' alternatives (Deep Learning, RL, Optimization/OR, LLMs/VLMs) are each labeled required, by analogy with the 'GCP, AWS, or Azure' handling in golden_001.
LLMs is also listed as 'is a strong plus', but the required mention in the expertise list wins.
Responsibility-only items are not labeled: feature engineering, model development, online experiments/A-B testing.
ai-deployment, observability and ai-infrastructure are mapped from generic wording ('deploying, monitoring... ML systems', 'ML infrastructure and tooling'). They are flagged uncertain.
Degree takes the highest level named, so PhD, per the golden_040 precedent. The parenthetical sits inside a required bullet with no optional marker, so it is required. It is flagged because the parenthetical reads as a list of acceptable levels.
The 'Experience in logistics... helpful but not required' bullet is domain knowledge, not a skill.
